column1: TC_ID | Title | Preconditions | Steps | Expected Result

HOM-001 | Home shows first-run cards when account has no content | User logged in, past First-Login Verification; account has 0 audiobooks, 0 documents, 0 recorded voices | 1. Open app to Home tab 2. Observe body content | HomeScreenState._isFirstRun is true (audiobooks.isEmpty && documents.isEmpty && voiceCount==0), so `_firstRunBody()` renders: card 1 "Bring your voice into every story" with action "Record your voice"; card 2 "Turn any PDF into an audiobook" with action "Add your first PDF"; card 3 "A library of 2,400+ audiobooks" with action "Browse the library"

HOM-002 | First-run masthead greeting reads "Welcome," | Same as HOM-001 (first-run account) | 1. Open Home tab while account has no content 2. Observe masthead greeting text | Masthead greeting is the literal string 'Welcome,' (not the time-based greeting), per `_isFirstRun ? 'Welcome,' : mwGreeting()`

HOM-003 | Home masthead shows time-based greeting and first name once content exists | User logged in; account has at least 1 audiobook or document or recorded voice (e.g. real account "Kazi" with 2 audiobooks + 1 PDF) | 1. Open Home tab 2. Observe masthead greeting and name | Greeting is `mwGreeting()` (time-based, e.g. "Good morning,"), not "Welcome,"; name shown is `mwFirstName(profile.full_name ?? user.name)` — e.g. "Kazi"; masthead name is sourced from `/api/me`'s `full_name` field, falling back to the locally-known user name if that call fails

HOM-004 | Home shows loading indicator while initial data fetches | User logged in, fresh navigation to Home tab | 1. Navigate to Home tab 2. Observe screen before network calls resolve | Body shows `Center(child: MwLoader(width: MwLoader.medium))` while `_loading` is true; masthead is still rendered above it

HOM-005 | Pull-to-refresh reloads Home data | User on Home tab with data already loaded | 1. Pull down on the Home list to trigger refresh | `RefreshIndicator.onRefresh` calls `load()` again, re-fetching `/api/me`, playback current, audiobooks, documents, capture sessions and volume, then rebuilds sections with fresh data

HOM-006 | Home renders empty sections rather than an error page on network failure | User logged in; simulate one or more of `/api/me`, playback/current, audiobooks list, documents list, or capture sessions failing | 1. Trigger Home load with one or more backing API calls failing 2. Observe screen | Each call is wrapped in `_safe()`, which catches errors and returns null; the affected section falls back to its empty value (e.g. empty audiobooks rail, empty documents grid, name falls back to `widget.user.name`) — no full-screen error is shown, screen remains otherwise usable

HOM-007 | "Nothing playing yet" hero shown when nothing has ever been played | User logged in; NowPlayingController has no book loaded and `/api/me`'s playback/current has no book (`_current == null` or `!hasBook`) | 1. Open Home tab with no playback history | Hero card shows title "Nothing playing yet" and body "Pick one of your audiobooks and it will pick up here, right where you left it." with a headphones icon placeholder cover; card is not tappable

HOM-008 | Last-played hero card reflects server's last position, gated on a matching owned book | User logged in; nothing currently loaded in the live player, but `/api/playback/current` returns a previously-played book | 1. Open Home tab 2. Observe hero card 3. Case A: the played book's id exists in `_myAudiobooks` 4. Case B: the played book's id is not found in `_myAudiobooks` | Card shows title (or "Untitled"), author or "{fraction*100}% complete", and a progress bar sized to `current.fraction`; in Case A the card and its play disc are tappable and open the player (playing only if `match.isPlayable`); in Case B `onTap` and `trailing` are null — the card is inert

HOM-009 | Live hero card reflects actively playing book with chapter/time and play-pause | User logged in; a book is currently loaded in NowPlayingController (e.g. just opened from the rail) | 1. Start playing an audiobook 2. Return to Home tab 3. Observe hero card while audio plays | Hero shows the live book's cover/title; meta is "Loading…" until duration is known, then "{Chapter N of M or 'In progress'} · {minutes-left text}"; minutes-left renders as "less than a minute left" (<1 min), "$m min left" (<60 min), or "$h h $m m left" (>=60 min); tapping the card opens PlayerScreen; the trailing disc shows a spinner while buffering/loading and toggles play/pause otherwise via `controller.togglePlayPause`

HOM-010 | Audiobooks rail empty state prompts recording | Account has 0 audiobooks (but may have documents/voices) | 1. Open Home tab with no narrated audiobooks | "Your audiobooks" rail area shows the empty row: icon, title "Nothing narrated yet", body "Record your voice, then turn any text into an audiobook.", and action button "Record" which calls `onRecordVoice`

HOM-011 | Audiobooks rail lists real books; playable vs. still-narrating tiles behave differently | Account has at least 1 audiobook, at least one of them still generating (not playable) | 1. Open Home tab 2. View "Your audiobooks" rail 3. Tap a playable tile 4. Tap a non-playable ("still narrating") tile 5. Tap the "All N" header action | Rail is a horizontal `ListView.separated` of `MwCarouselTile`s labelled with the book title and "Read by {voiceStyle}" or "Your voice"; playable tiles open the player via `onOpenPlayer`; non-playable tiles render dimmed (`dim: true`) and have `onTap: null`; the section header shows "All {count}" only when `_myAudiobooks` is non-empty and tapping it calls `onOpenLibrary`, switching the shell to the Library tab

HOM-012 | PDF grid shows dimmed sample cards with disclosure note when account has no documents | Account has 0 uploaded PDFs | 1. Open Home tab with no documents | "Your books · PDF" area shows `MwSampleData.myDocuments` rendered 2-up at opacity 0.55, each with `onTap: null` (not tappable), captioned "Examples — add a PDF and yours appear here." below

HOM-013 | PDF grid shows real documents and opens the page picker on tap | Account has at least 1 uploaded PDF (e.g. a 34-page PDF) | 1. Open Home tab with a document present 2. Observe the PDF card 3. Tap the card | Card title is the filename with extension stripped, meta is "{pageCount} pages" (e.g. "34 pages"); documents render two per row in API order; tapping navigates to `BookPagesScreen` for that document, and Home reloads (`load()`) on return

HOM-014 | Adding a PDF from Home: success path uploads, refreshes, and opens the page picker; cancel is a no-op | User logged in on Home tab | 1. Trigger "Add your first PDF" / add-PDF action 2. In the file picker, cancel without choosing a file 3. Repeat, this time selecting a valid PDF | Cancelling (picker returns null path) does nothing — no snackbar, no upload; selecting a file shows snackbar "Uploading your PDF…", uploads via `DocumentsService.upload`, then calls `_refreshAll()` across all four tabs and opens `BookPagesScreen` for the new document

HOM-015 | PDF upload failure surfaces an error snackbar | User logged in; PDF upload will fail (e.g. server/network error) | 1. Pick a PDF to upload 2. Simulate upload failure | Snackbar shows "Upload failed: $e" with the caught exception; Home is not refreshed and no navigation occurs

HOM-016 | Bottom navigation switches tabs and preserves each tab's state | User logged in, on any tab | 1. Scroll/interact on Home tab (e.g. scroll list) 2. Tap "Today" in bottom nav 3. Tap "Library" 4. Tap "Voices" 5. Return to "Home" | Tapping a tab updates `_tabIndex` and the body swaps within an `IndexedStack`, so each screen's scroll position/state is preserved (not rebuilt) when navigating away and back; tab labels are Home/Today/Library/Voices with icons `home`/`calendar_today`/`library_books`/`graphic_eq`

HOM-017 | Mini-player strip is hidden on Today but shown on other tabs while something plays | A book is currently loaded/playing in NowPlayingController | 1. Start playing a book 2. Switch to Today tab 3. Switch to Home, Library, and Voices tabs in turn | On Today tab the mini-player strip renders as `SizedBox.shrink()` (Today has its own resume card with playback controls, so the strip is suppressed); on Home/Library/Voices it shows the strip with the book title and meta "Read by {voiceStyle}" or "Your voice", a play/pause toggle, and tapping it opens PlayerScreen

HOM-018 | Today tab masthead shows fixed "Today," greeting and user's first name | User logged in, viewing Today tab | 1. Open Today tab | Masthead greeting is the literal 'Today,' (never time-based) and name is `mwFirstName(profile.fullName)` from `ProfileService.me()`

HOM-019 | Today resume card reflects the live playing book with elapsed/total clock and toggle | A book is currently loaded/playing in NowPlayingController | 1. Open Today tab while a book is playing | Card shows eyebrow "PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF", the book cover/title, and either "Loading…" (duration unknown) or "{position} of {duration}" in mm:ss or h:mm:ss format; progress bar reflects `position/duration`; tapping the card opens the player; the circular button toggles play/pause via `controller.togglePlayPause`

HOM-020 | Today shows "A quiet day so far" when nothing has ever been played and no playable audiobooks exist | Nothing loaded in the live player; account's audiobooks list is empty or none are `isPlayable` | 1. Open Today tab with no playback history and no playable audiobooks | Card shows "A quiet day so far" with body "Nothing has been played yet. Narrate something in your own voice and it will wait for you here." — non-interactive (no onTap)

HOM-021 | Today suggests the newest playable audiobook when nothing is live but one exists | Nothing loaded in the live player; account has at least one audiobook with `isPlayable == true` | 1. Open Today tab | Card shows eyebrow "START WHERE YOU LEFT OFF", the first playable audiobook's title, and "Read by {voiceStyle}" or "Narrated in your voice"; tapping the card calls `onOpenPlayer` for that book

HOM-022 | Today stat tiles show placeholders on failure and correct values on success | Case A: `/profile/stats` fails; Case B: stats load successfully with known hours/finished/audiobooks counts | 1. Open Today tab under Case A 2. Observe "Your listening" tiles 3. Repeat under Case B | On failure all three tiles ("Hours", "Finished", "Narrated") show "—"; on success each shows the rounded value zero-padded to 2 digits (e.g. "05"), via `two(value)`

HOM-023 | Today "Picked for today" shows dimmed samples with a disclosure toast when the catalogue is empty, or real titles that open the book detail sheet | Case A: `CatalogueService.list()` returns empty; Case B: catalogue returns at least one title | 1. Open Today tab under Case A, tap a pick tile 2. Repeat under Case B, tap a pick tile | Case A: tiles are `MwSampleData.audiobooks` at opacity 0.72 with caption "Examples — the catalogue fills in once titles are published."; tapping one shows snackbar "The public catalogue is not open yet — these are examples."; Case B: real `Book` titles render undimmed and tapping one opens `showBookDetailSheet` for that book

LIB-001 | Library shows loading indicator while initial data fetches | User logged in, navigating to Library tab | 1. Navigate to Library tab 2. Observe screen before data resolves | Body shows `Center(child: MwLoader(width: MwLoader.medium))` while `_loading` is true; header, search bar and shelf segmented control render above it regardless

LIB-002 | Library header text reflects preview vs. real counts for both shelves | Case A: all three public catalogues (books/voices/pdfs) empty, no owned documents/audiobooks; Case B: catalogues and owned items both populated | 1. Open Library on Public shelf under Case A, then Case B 2. Switch to "Your Library" shelf under Case A, then Case B | Public/Case A: "{sample audiobooks+voices+documents count} titles · a preview of the store"; Public/Case B: "{published count} title(s) · yours to narrate" with correct singular/plural; Your Library/Case A (nothing owned): "Nothing of yours here yet"; Your Library/Case B: "{owned count} item(s) · yours to narrate" with correct singular/plural

LIB-003 | Public / Your Library segmented control switches shelves | User on Library tab with data loaded | 1. Tap "Your Library" segment 2. Tap "Public" segment | Body swaps between `_publicShelf()` (with category chips + price tabs) and `_yourShelf()` (dashed actions + owned items); category chips and price tabs are visible only on the Public shelf

LIB-004 | Public shelf category and price filters narrow results correctly | Public shelf; catalogue contains a mix of free and paid audiobooks, voices, and PDFs | 1. Select "Audiobook" category, then "Voice", then "PDF" 2. On each category, select "All", "Free", then "Paid" price tabs | Category chip selection switches which of `_publicAudiobookRows()`/`_voiceRows()`/`_publicPdfRows()` is displayed; price tab applies `_matchesPrice()` (All: no filter, Free: `isFree==true`, Paid: `isFree==false`) to whichever shelf (real or sample) is showing, filtering the visible rows accordingly

LIB-005 | Search filters rows on both shelves with distinct empty-state copy | Public shelf has searchable titles; a search term matches nothing | 1. Enter a search term matching an existing title 2. Clear it and enter a term matching nothing, with price filter on "All" 3. Switch price filter to "Free" with an empty search term but a shelf that returns no free rows | Matching term filters rows case-insensitively on title/author (or trait line for voices) via `_matches()`; step 2 shows empty state 'No {kind} match "{query}".'; step 3 (no query, filtered by price) shows 'No {free/paid} {kind} yet.' — the two empty messages are distinct and mutually exclusive based on whether `_query` is non-empty

LIB-006 | Clear-search (x) button appears only with text and clears the field | Library search bar | 1. Type text into the search field 2. Tap the x icon that appears | The x icon only renders when `_searchController.text.isNotEmpty`; tapping it clears the controller and re-filters all shelves to the unfiltered state

LIB-007 | Voice search shows a permission prompt when unavailable | Device/emulator denies microphone or speech-recognition access | 1. Tap the mic icon in the search bar | `_speech.initialize()` returns false/unavailable; snackbar shows "Voice search needs microphone and speech permission."; `_listening` stays false, mic icon remains `mic_none`

LIB-008 | Voice search listening state updates UI and populates the search field | Microphone/speech permission granted | 1. Tap the mic icon to start listening 2. Speak a phrase 3. Tap the mic icon again to stop | While listening: search bar border tints accent color, hint text becomes "Listening…", mic icon becomes filled `mic`; recognized words populate `_searchController.text` live via `onResult`; tapping again calls `_speech.stop()` and sets `_listening` back to false

LIB-009 | Public Audiobook shelf falls back to dimmed sample rows with a store-preview caption when the catalogue is empty | `/api/books` returns no titles | 1. Open Library, Public shelf, Audiobook category | Rows render from `MwSampleData.audiobooks` at opacity 0.72; below the list, a caption box reads "A preview of the store" / "These titles and voices show how the public shelf will look. Nothing has been published here yet."; tapping any sample row calls `_sampleTapped()`, showing snackbar "The store is not stocked yet — this row is an example."

LIB-010 | Public Audiobook shelf shows real catalogue rows with correct ownership badge and opens the detail sheet | `/api/books` returns at least one title, some owned and some not | 1. Open Library, Public shelf, Audiobook category 2. Tap an owned title 3. Tap an unowned title | Rows show meta "{genre or author} · {durationLabel}"; owned titles show an `MwStatusPill` "Yours"; unowned show a price badge; tapping either opens `showBookDetailSheet` for that book

LIB-011 | Tapping an already-acquired voice shows a toast without a confirm dialog | Public shelf, Voice category; at least one listed voice has `canNarrate == true` | 1. Tap a voice already in the user's picker | No dialog appears; snackbar shows '"{name}" is already in your voice picker.'

LIB-012 | Acquiring a voice: free voice confirms and succeeds; paid voice shows price and can fail | Public shelf, Voice category; one unowned free voice and one unowned paid voice available | 1. Tap the unowned free voice, confirm "Add it" 2. Tap the unowned paid voice, observe dialog price text, confirm "Add it", simulate acquire failure | Dialog title '"Use "{name}"?"'; free voice body: "This voice is free. It will appear when you pick a voice to narrate with."; paid voice body includes "This voice costs {formatted price}. It will appear when you pick a voice to narrate with."; on confirmed success, `_voices.acquire()` runs, the shelf reloads, and toast shows '"{name}" is yours to narrate with.'; on failure toast shows "Could not add that voice: $e" and the voice remains unacquired

LIB-013 | Acquiring a catalogue PDF: dialog for unowned (free/paid), direct navigation for owned | Public shelf, PDF category; one unowned free PDF, one unowned paid PDF, and one already-owned PDF available | 1. Tap the unowned free PDF, confirm "Add it" 2. Tap the unowned paid PDF, observe "Buy for {price}" button, confirm 3. Tap the already-owned PDF | Unowned free: dialog body "Add this to your library to narrate it.", confirm button "Add it"; unowned paid: dialog body includes "This costs {priceLabel}...", confirm button "Buy for {priceLabel}"; after successful `_pdfs.acquire()`, both cases push `AudiobooksScreen` with `sourcePdfId` and a summary "{title} · {pageCount} pages"; the already-owned PDF skips the dialog entirely and navigates straight to `AudiobooksScreen`

LIB-014 | Your Library dashed actions trigger the shared add-PDF and narrate-text flows | Your Library shelf | 1. Tap "Add a PDF" dashed row 2. Tap "Narrate your own text" dashed row | "Add a PDF" (sub: "Turn any document into an audiobook") invokes `widget.onAddPdf` (same file picker/upload flow as Home); "Narrate your own text" (sub: "Paste a letter, a chapter, anything") invokes `widget.onNarrateText`, opening `AudiobooksScreen` with an empty text box

LIB-015 | Your Library empty state differs for "nothing owned" vs. "no search match" | Case A: account owns nothing (no documents, audiobooks, or store PDFs); Case B: account owns items but current search term matches none | 1. Open Your Library shelf with no search text under Case A 2. Under Case B, type a non-matching search term | Case A message: "Add a PDF or record your voice, and everything you make lands here."; Case B message: 'Nothing of yours matches "{query}".'

LIB-016 | Favouriting a document persists locally and updates instantly | Your Library shelf; at least one uploaded document present | 1. Tap the heart icon on a document row 2. Observe icon state 3. Restart search/reload and check state persists 4. Tap the heart again to un-favourite | Icon toggles between `favorite_border` (not favourited) and filled `favorite` (accent color) immediately via `LocalFavourites.toggle()`, which persists the id set to `SharedPreferences` under key `mw_favourite_documents_v1`; this is device-local only (no server sync) per `LocalFavourites`' Favourites-API-covers-catalogue-only design note

LIB-017 | Long-pressing a document offers delete with confirm, optimistic removal, and rollback on failure | Your Library shelf; at least one uploaded document present | 1. Long-press a document row 2. In the dialog, tap "Keep" 3. Long-press again, tap "Remove", simulate a successful delete 4. Repeat, this time simulating delete failure | Dialog title "Remove this PDF?", body '"{title}" will be removed from your library. Audiobooks already narrated from it are unaffected.'; "Keep" dismisses with no change; "Remove" on success optimistically removes the row immediately then calls `DocumentsService.delete`; on failure the row list is restored via `load()` and snackbar shows "Delete failed: $e"

LIB-018 | Your Library audiobook rows show narrating vs. playable state distinctly | Your Library shelf; account has one playable audiobook and one still generating | 1. Open Your Library shelf 2. Observe both audiobook rows | Playable row meta: "Narrated by {voiceStyle or 'your voice'}" with an accent `play_circle_outline` icon; still-generating row meta: "Still narrating · {status}", entire row rendered at 0.6 opacity (dimmed) with an `hourglass_empty` icon in ink3 color and no tap action for narration state (row itself has no onTap defined for audiobooks)

LIB-019 | Store-acquired PDFs (not uploads) are labeled and open directly without an acquire dialog | Your Library shelf; account has acquired at least one catalogue PDF (not their own upload) | 1. Open Your Library shelf 2. Observe the store-PDF row's meta text 3. Tap the row | Meta includes "from the store" alongside author/page count; since `pdf.isOwned` is already true, `_openCataloguePdf` skips the acquire dialog and navigates straight to `AudiobooksScreen` with `sourcePdfId`

LIB-020 | Book detail sheet shows fallback text when a catalogue title has no description | Tap any catalogue book whose `description` is null/empty | 1. Open a catalogue title's detail sheet with no description | Sheet shows "No description yet for this title." in place of the description paragraph

LIB-021 | Book detail sheet favourite toggle updates state and reports failures | Book detail sheet open for a catalogue title | 1. Tap the heart icon to favourite the title, simulate success 2. Tap again to un-favourite, simulate failure | On success, icon updates immediately (filled/accent when favourited, outline/ink3 otherwise) via `CatalogueService.addFavourite`/`removeFavourite`; on failure, snackbar shows "Could not update favourite: $e" and state does not change

LIB-022 | Book detail sheet primary action differs by ownership; acquire failures keep the sheet open | Case A: title already owned; Case B: title unowned and free; Case C: title unowned and paid, acquire will fail | 1. Open detail sheet for an owned title, tap the button 2. Open detail sheet for an unowned free title, tap the button, simulate success 3. Open detail sheet for an unowned paid title, tap the button, simulate failure | Case A: button reads "Narrate in your voice"; tapping pops the sheet and pushes `AudiobooksScreen` with `sourceBookId`; Case B: button reads "Add to your library"; on success, `_book` updates in place (retaining the current favourite flag) and toast shows '"{title}" is yours.'; Case C: button reads "Buy for {priceLabel}" and shows a loading state while busy; on failure toast shows "Could not add that title: $e" and the sheet stays open with the title still unowned

LIB-023 | Book pages screen loading and error states | Navigate to a document's page picker (e.g. the account's 34-page PDF) | 1. Open the document from Library/Home 2. Observe screen before text loads 3. Simulate the `/api/documents/{id}/text` call failing | While loading, body shows `Center(child: MwLoader(...))`; on failure, body shows centered text "Could not load this book: $e" in accent color, and no page list or action buttons render

LIB-024 | Book pages screen lists every page with correct metadata and truncated preview | Document text loads successfully (e.g. 34 pages) | 1. Open the page picker for the document 2. Scroll through the page list | Each row title reads "Page {n} · {chars} chars"; the subtitle shows the page's text verbatim if <=140 characters, or the first 140 characters plus "…" if longer, capped at 2 lines with ellipsis overflow; header line above the list reads "{selected} / {total} pages · {selectedChars} / {maxChars} chars" (maxChars defaults to 20000 if the server doesn't supply one)

LIB-025 | Selecting pages enforces the 20,000-character cap | Document with combined page character count exceeding 20,000 | 1. Select pages one at a time until the next page would push the running total over the max 2. Attempt to select that next page 3. Deselect an already-selected page | Selecting a page that would push `_selectedChars + page.chars` above `_maxChars` is blocked with snackbar "That would exceed the 20,000 character limit." and the checkbox stays unchecked; pages already within the cap toggle normally; deselecting a selected page always succeeds regardless of the cap

LIB-026 | "Select from start" and "Clear" bulk-select controls work as documented | Book pages screen with text loaded | 1. Tap "SELECT FROM START (WITHIN LIMIT)" 2. Tap "CLEAR" | "Select from start" walks pages in document order, adding each to the selection while the running total stays within `_maxChars`, stopping at the first page that would exceed it (replacing any prior selection); "Clear" empties `_selectedPages` entirely, resetting the counter to "0 / {total} pages · 0 / {maxChars} chars"

LIB-027 | "Use Selection in Audiobooks" is gated on selection and passes pages in document order | Book pages screen with text loaded | 1. With zero pages selected, observe the bottom button 2. Select pages out of visual/tap order (e.g. page 5 before page 2) 3. Tap "Use Selection in Audiobooks ->" | Button is disabled (`onPressed: null`) when `_selectedPages` is empty; once at least one page is selected it becomes enabled; on tap, selected pages are sorted ascending by page number and their trimmed text is joined with a blank line, then `AudiobooksScreen` is pushed with `initialTitle` "{filename without .pdf} — p. {firstPage}–{lastPage}", `initialText` set to the joined text, and `sourceFilename` set to the original filename
